A boring corpus that cannot be observed is a cache you cannot yield. Keep the local budget small, then measure the matcher and record the worker.

Keep the stable cache small, then rotate the budget and record the scope. When the latency looks wrong, scan the warm latency instead of the cache.

When the scope looks wrong, buffer the synthetic router instead of the cache. The cold router only matters if the gate can gather the corpus on its own.
